exposure: pain intensity (NRS scores at maximum pain after CS)
outcome: postoperative pain intensity on day 5 after cesarean section (NRS scores during activity and at rest)
cohort: The study included 124 postpartum women who had undergone a cesarean section in Mie Prefecture, Japan.
finding: Initial maximum postoperative pain significantly influenced pain intensity on Postoperative Day 5 (POD5) after cesarean section, while the number of oral analgesics and pain self-efficacy (PSEQ-J scores) did not.
